subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity increase + co-term question
messages:
From: Claire Sun <claire@brightbeam.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@brightbeam.ai
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-contract capacity bump & co-term question

Hi Tessa,

Quick one — our usage has spiked ahead of schedule and we need to add 60k extra genotype embeddings/mo for the next 9 months. We want that capacity to be billed and co-termed to our existing contract (renewal 2027-09-30).

Questions: can you do a short-term top-up that aligns to our existing renewal date (pro-rate for the 9 months) and what pricing/discounts are available for this mid-contract add? We prefer not to sign a separate annual up-front commit.

Attached sample usage for May.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Sun
Head of ML Eng, BrightBeam AI
[Attachment: BrightBeam-usage-may.csv (csv)]

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Claire Sun <claire@brightbeam.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity bump & co-term question

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and upload. We can absolutely support a temporary capacity top-up and co-term it to your 2027-09-30 renewal. A few quick clarifying items so I can put together a clean amendment:

- Is the requested 60k embeddings/mo steady for the full 9 months or front-loaded?
- Do you need dedicated capacity (Redwood Dedicated) or is hosted API with a committed monthly top-up OK?
- Any contract/legal constraints from procurement beyond standard SOW amendments?

Two commercial options I can propose quickly (subject to internal approval):
1) Short-term top-up (hosted): pro-rated monthly billing aligned to your renewal, standard hosted pricing + 8% volume discount for the 9-month window.
2) Temporary dedicated bucket (if latency/cost matters): 9-month reserved capacity at a 12% effective discount, with a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration costs.

I asked Ben and Rishi to weigh in on approval thresholds — looping them in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity bump & co-term question

Tessa / Rishi — quick internal: BrightBeam is a healthy expansion opportunity; they skew towards higher throughput and will be stickier if we give a smooth path. Guidelines:

- For hosted top-ups under 12 months we cap discounts at 10% unless they commit to an annual uplift.
- Dedicated reserved pools: can approve up to 15% discount with a one-time professional services/onboarding credit (max $7k) if they sign a 9+ month reserved window and accept co-term.

If Claire is sensitive to up-front commits, offer option 1 with a 10% discount and a $2k onboarding credit for migration. If they take the dedicated option, put 12% discount + $6k credit and require a simple amendment that co-terms to 2027-09-30.

Approve me to offer bridged credits but flag as an exception if they ask for more.

-Ben
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity bump & co-term question

Agree with Ben. Couple tactical points:

- Push for a 9-month minimum for the dedicated path; otherwise the slot hurts our capacity planning.
- Include a clause that any unconsumed capacity in the 9-month window can be rolled forward to the renewal as a one-time conversion credit (helps procurement feel safe).
- For hosted top-up, price it as add-on with monthly true-up and a discount ladder starting at 7% and capping at 10% if they confirm steady usage after month 2.

If Tessa wants, I can draft the amendment language for co-term and the forward-credit clause.

-Rishi
Head of Renewals Operations, Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Claire Sun <claire@brightbeam.ai>
Cc: contracts@brightbeam.ai, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity bump & co-term question

Hi Claire — thanks again for the usage file and patience while we scoped options. Here is what we can offer for BrightBeam (proposal attached):

Option A — Hosted top-up (no annual pre-pay)
- 60k embeddings/mo for 9 months, pro-rated and billed monthly to co-term 2027-09-30.
- 10% volume discount off list for the 9-month window.
- $2,000 one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice.
- If usage in months 1–2 stabilizes above 75% of committed monthly units, discount remains; otherwise we reserve right to revert to list pricing for remaining months.

Option B — Temporary Dedicated bucket (recommended if cost/latency is a priority)
- 9-month reserved capacity, co-term to 2027-09-30.
- 12% discount off equivalent hosted list price.
- $6,000 onboarding & migration credit.
- Unconsumed capacity during the 9 months may be converted to a renewal credit applied at your 2027 renewal (one-time rollover).

Next steps: pick preferred option and confirm whether you need a PO. If you want the amendment, we'll send a tracked PDF and route to Contracts. I’ve attached a short amendment draft and the usage file you provided.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if useful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Proposed-amendment-BB-042.pdf (pdf)]
